config.label: Register the mutating tools
config.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.

config.label: Restrict every read and write to these Mail accounts, by name
config.description: Restrict every read and write to these Mail accounts, by name. Bounds reading, not just writing.

config.label: Let the compose tools attach a local file and send in the same call
config.description: Let the compose tools attach a local file and send in the same call. Attaching to a draft needs only writes; this is off by default because an immediate send puts the file in someone's inbox with nobody reviewing it.
